lua_assertions:
local function po(player, level, name, ...)
    return _ITG_OPTIONS_AT(player, 'ModsLevel_' .. level, name, ...)
end
for player = 0, 1 do
    po(player, 'Preferred', 'SetPlayerOptions', player == 0 and 'reverse' or '')
end
for player = 0, 1 do
    local expected = player == 0 and 1 or 0
    for _, level in ipairs({'Preferred', 'Stage', 'Song', 'Current'}) do
        assert(po(player, level, 'Reverse') == expected, level .. ' must inherit saved Reverse')
    end
    -- ULTRA SYNERGY MATRIX saves this before resetting its template.
    local using_reverse = po(player, 'Song', 'Reverse') ~= 0
    po(player, 'Song', 'FromString', '*10000 0 reverse')
    assert(po(player, 'Song', 'Reverse') == 0)
    assert(po(player, 'Preferred', 'Reverse') == expected)
    if using_reverse then
        po(player, 'Song', 'FromString', '*10000 100 reverse')
    end
    assert(po(player, 'Song', 'Reverse') == expected)
end
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(0.1)
for player = 0, 1 do
    assert(po(player, 'Current', 'Reverse') == (player == 0 and 1 or 0))
end
-- Fresh assignment must still reset Reverse; seeding is not a getter fallback.
po(0, 'Stage', 'SetPlayerOptions', '')
assert(po(0, 'Preferred', 'Reverse') == 1)
for _, level in ipairs({'Stage', 'Song', 'Current'}) do
    assert(po(0, level, 'Reverse') == 0)
end
